title:
Epic to save the current values of a form in the application state.

This epic will retrieve the current values of the form fields and save them in the application state.
If the form has previously saved values, they will be updated with the new values.

The epic accepts the following parameters:
formIds {string[]} - The names of the forms to be saved in the application state.

Returns a `SET_FIELD` action to update the `valuesByFormId` field in the application state with the new form values.
name: UiSdlSaveFormFieldValuesInAppState
